result:
The billing component now shows a "Manage billing" link below the status line. It points at `https://homelab.local/billing/portal`, read from the shared config. Both PRs are merged, CI and CD were green on each, and `st done` is recorded. I only checked the built `dist/main.js` for the link text. I did not look at the live page.

- **PR #1, `libs-shared-contracts`:** adds `billingPortalUrl` to `SHARED_CONFIG` and bumps the version from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0. The bump is needed because CD only publishes a library when its version is new. The registry now has 1.0.0 and 1.1.0.
- **PR #2, `apps-sub-route-billing`:** raises the dependency to `@mfe/shared-contracts@^1.1.0`, with `package.json` and `package-lock.json` committed. It adds the link, with the address coming from `SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl` instead of being hardcoded.

The billing app doesn't pick up a new library version on its own, so the dependency bump had to ship in the same PR as the link. The two PRs also had to merge in order, contracts first. Nothing else slowed me down.

Assumption: I styled the link in the component's existing green accent colour, since the ticket doesn't specify styling.
